title: ISS Full Portrait (STS-132)
explanation: The Space Shuttle Atlantis photographed the ISS at its full extent during the STS-132 mission.

title: ISS Over a Moonlit Ocean
explanation: The International Space Station orbits at 408 km altitude above a moonlit ocean.

title: EVA at Sunrise
explanation: An astronaut conducts a spacewalk during orbital sunrise, the curve of the Earth glowing golden beneath.

title: Orion Over the Moon
explanation: The Orion spacecraft during Artemis I at closest approach to the lunar surface — 130 km above the Moon.
